This is a removal of working functionality, so I want a yes before touching it.

**Consequence:** `#export-csv` is the only way to get report data out of the page — after this, anyone who still relies on it (including bookmarks, docs, or a workflow that walks the reports page) has no export path, and the CSV serialization logic goes with it. `export.js` exists solely for this handler, so the whole file becomes dead and would be deleted, not just the listener.

Scope if you confirm:
- `index.html:7` — delete the button
- `index.html:8` — delete the `<script src="export.js">` tag
- `export.js` — delete the file (nothing else references it)

Nothing in the repo consumes the export other than these two files, so the deletion is self-contained; the risk is entirely about users/processes outside the repo.
